title: Political Neutrality in AI Is Impossible — But Here Is How to Approximate It

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with a curated dataset of U.S.-centric political queries (covering voting questions, universal rights, harmful political questions, political opinions, and conspiracy theories) and using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) verified by human evaluators to classify the generated responses into political neutrality approximation categories (Refusal, Avoidance, Reasonable Pluralism, Output Transparency, No Approximation, and Bias).
